title: Issues
date_order: Target date must be on or after start date.
effort_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000, or leave blank.
title_invalid: Use a single-line title of 1–255 characters.
move_help: Choose a target team and resolve its status, labels, project and milestone explicitly. Other issue fields are retained.
resolve_selections: Resolve unavailable or incompatible status, labels, project and milestone selections before saving. Projects must include the selected team.
stale_draft: This issue changed. Your draft is preserved. Discard it to start again from the latest version.
load_error: Could not load the latest data.
save_error: The result of this request could not be confirmed.
validation_error: The request was rejected. Edit it and try again.
version_conflict: The request conflicts with the latest version. Review the current state before starting a new request.
pending_help: These requests remain available after changing filters or moving and archiving issues. Review the latest state before retrying an uncertain request or discarding it.
reconcile_help: Review completed. You may discard this draft and start again.
